fields.description: GunBroker's own order number. The idempotency key for order polling: unique at the database level, so a replayed or overlapping poll updates the existing order instead of creating a second one.
fields.label: GunBroker Order ID

fields.description: Our OWN fulfillment state, not GunBroker's. Transferred means the bound-book exit is booked.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: GunBroker's numeric order status as last polled (1-13).
fields.label: GunBroker Status

fields.description: When the buyer bought it. Site local time, converted from GunBroker's orderDateUTC (or, where GunBroker sends no UTC twin, from its Eastern reading — D-13). The value they sent is kept verbatim in Raw Payload.
fields.label: Order Date

fields.description: lastModifiedDate as GunBroker reports it — what the incremental poll orders by and advances its watermark to. Site local time, converted from GunBroker's lastModifiedDate (or, where GunBroker sends no UTC twin, from its Eastern reading — D-13). The value they sent is kept verbatim in Raw Payload. The watermark itself, over in GunBroker Settings, stays in UTC: it is an API protocol value, not an accounting one, and is never compared with anything on this document.
fields.label: GunBroker Last Modified

fields.description: When PUT /Orders/{id}/Flags {AcknowledgeOrder:true} succeeded. Empty means the order is still awaiting seller review on GunBroker.
fields.label: Acknowledged At

fields.description: buyer.userID — the Customer dedup key. A GunBroker username can change; the numeric id cannot.
fields.label: Buyer User ID

fields.description: GunBroker's own taxExempt flag for this order. Recorded, never used to change a Customer's exemption.
fields.label: Tax Exempt

fields.description: The receiving dealer's licence number as GunBroker reports it (fflNumber). Staff may correct it in the C&R dialog; doing so also clears atf_ffl_record, so the two can never describe different licences.
fields.label: FFL Number

fields.description: The resolved destination, from eZ Check (or the C&R dialog). What the disposition actually ships to.
fields.label: ATF FFL Record

fields.description: Derived from ffl_number, never stored independently: a Type 03 collector is not in the ATF directory, so this order needs the human verification dialog instead of an eZ Check lookup.
fields.label: C&R (Type 03) Transfer

fields.description: Set by Dispose when no receiving dealer was involved: every gun on the order is an antique, so it was issued out of stock with no bound-book entry and ships to the buyer's own address.
fields.label: Ships Direct to Buyer (antique)

fields.description: When GunBroker's Master FFL service recorded the receiving dealer's licence. Site local time, converted from GunBroker's fflReceivedDateUTC (or, where GunBroker sends no UTC twin, from its Eastern reading — D-13). The value they sent is kept verbatim in Raw Payload.
fields.label: FFL Received At

fields.description: Mirrors GunBroker's paymentReceived. Reporting only: a click on the GunBroker site sets it, which is not evidence that WE recorded the money — the Dispose gate reads payment_mode_used instead.
fields.label: Payment Received (GunBroker flag)

fields.description: When GunBroker says the buyer paid. Their flag, not evidence the money reached us — the Dispose gate reads Payment Received On, which a human fills in. Site local time, converted from GunBroker's paymentReceivedDateUTC (or, where GunBroker sends no UTC twin, from its Eastern reading — D-13). The value they sent is kept verbatim in Raw Payload.
fields.label: Payment Received At (GunBroker)

fields.description: paymentMethods, decoded from GunBroker's bitmask into words.
fields.label: Payment Methods Offered

fields.description: How the money reached us. Anything Gateway (*) is an anomaly this phase: no payment gateway is connected, so no card money should exist.
fields.label: Payment Source
fields.options:
Gateway (Immediate Checkout)
Check or Money Order
Gateway (GB-set)
Unknown

fields.description: Written ONLY by mark_payment_received. Non-empty is the single fact that means 'we have really recorded this money', and it is what opens the Dispose gate.
fields.label: Mode of Payment Recorded

fields.description: The day the cheque went INTO the bank, not the day it arrived in the post. Never the Payment Entry's posting date (that follows the invoice); this drives the cash-basis schedule and bank reconciliation. Invariant: a recorded mode of payment always has this date.
fields.label: Deposited On

fields.description: Idempotency key for collection: non-empty means the money is on the ledger.
fields.label: Payment Entry

fields.description: The second entry when a cheque was for more than the invoice. Empty on an exactly-paid order; empty on an overpaid one means the top-up has not been booked yet and the next booking run will try again.
fields.label: Overpayment Entry

fields.description: The timestamp on GunBroker's own payment log entry, where there is one. Site local time, converted from GunBroker's paymentLogDateTime (or, where GunBroker sends no UTC twin, from its Eastern reading — D-13). The value they sent is kept verbatim in Raw Payload.
fields.label: Payment Log Date

fields.description: totalPrice — everything GunBroker says the buyer owes.
fields.label: Order Total

fields.description: salesTaxTotal — GunBroker's combined figure: the marketplace-facilitator sales tax PLUS the 1% buyer service fee. The two go to different liability accounts, so it is split by compliance_fee and never guessed at.
fields.label: Sales Tax Total (incl. service fee)

fields.description: complianceFee — the buyer's 1%, which GunBroker keeps. Missing this field means the tax split cannot be computed, so the invoice is left in Draft rather than posted wrong.
fields.label: Marketplace Service Fee

fields.description: Idempotency key for the seller-fee accrual.
fields.label: Fee Accrual Journal Entry

fields.description: Step 1 of the write-back succeeded. GunBroker will not set this flag for us when tracking is uploaded — it has to be sent.
fields.label: OrderShipped Flag Sent At

fields.description: Step 2 succeeded.
fields.label: Tracking Sent At

fields.description: Set only when step 2 or step 3 failed: the tracking number did not land, or the read-back did not agree. The tracking poll keeps retrying exactly the step that is missing.
fields.label: Ship Write-back Pending

fields.description: When GunBroker cancelled the order. Site local time, converted from GunBroker's cancelDate (or, where GunBroker sends no UTC twin, from its Eastern reading — D-13). The value they sent is kept verbatim in Raw Payload.
fields.label: Cancelled At

fields.description: When GunBroker refunded the order. Site local time, converted from GunBroker's refundDate (or, where GunBroker sends no UTC twin, from its Eastern reading — D-13). The value they sent is kept verbatim in Raw Payload.
fields.label: Refunded At

fields.description: When GunBroker recorded the return. Site local time, converted from GunBroker's returnedDate (or, where GunBroker sends no UTC twin, from its Eastern reading — D-13). The value they sent is kept verbatim in Raw Payload.
fields.label: Returned At

fields.description: Fill this in once the chargeback has been dealt with — written off, represented, or recovered. The daily audit reports every chargeback until it is set, which is deliberate and also why it has to be possible to stop.
fields.label: Chargeback Handled At

fields.description: Fill this in once the cancellation's refund is booked: an unreferenced Receive entry reversed by a Pay entry, both carrying "GunBroker Order #" and the GunBroker order number in Remarks (tick Custom Remarks first); the Pay entry must be submitted, to the customer (Party Type Customer), in the same company, one order per entry. Nothing in POS can see a refund happen, so the daily audit reports a cancelled order that was paid for until this is set; that is deliberate, and it is also why it has to be possible to stop.
fields.label: Refund Handled At

fields.description: The last GET /Orders/{id} body, for evidence. Buyer PII, no credentials.
fields.label: Raw GunBroker Payload
